title: Crypto misuse: wolfssl GCM set_tag accepts truncated auth tags
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm set_tag at src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_gcm.c:289 accepts taglen from 1 to 16 with no minimum enforcement. FIPS 140-3 requires GCM authentication tags be at least 96 bits (12 bytes). Trigger: caller sets taglen=4, provider accepts, GCM encryption/decryption runs with 32-bit tag. Outcome: 2^32 forgery probability vs 2^128 — authentication guarantee destroyed silently. A tag of 4 bytes provides essentially no authentication against an active adversary.
close_reason: Changed taglen minimum from >0 to >=12 in wolfssl_aes_gcm_set_tag; FIPS 140-3 SP 800-38D requires 96-bit minimum
